messages:
maria: heads-up team 1: we've observed sporadic panics in serving when handling long-lived streamed responses. root cause points to grpc-stream v1.12.3. pausing the release train for 12h while we patch / mitigate.

ben: do we have crash signatures? where are they hitting most?

maria: crash sigs look like 'panic: runtime error: invalid memory address' inside grpc-stream stream.go:412 under high-concurrency. primarily on p95 traffic for streaming embeddings. stack traces in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/grpc-stream-panic

tay: mitigation options? can we pin the dep or hotpatch the build?

maria: plan of action:
1) set release freeze for 12h across eng-release train
2) hold any merges touching serving/streaming or vendor deps
3) create emergency patch branch that pins grpc-stream to v1.12.2 and rebuild images
4) steer 100% of test and canary traffic to the rebuilt images, then slowly shift prod if green

release-bot: :warning: Release freeze active for eng-release train for 12 hours. No merges touching serving/streaming, vendor/, or build scripts. To request an exemption, add label `freeze-ex` and ping @ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: i've created a runbook and increased heartbeat alert sensitivity for streaming workers. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/grpc-stream-panic - follow steps under 'emergency patch'. I'll also open a pager if crash rate > 2/hr.

ben: starting emergency branch now. command i use to pin: `go get github.com/grpc/stream@v1.12.2 && go mod tidy && bazel build //cmd/serving`

devops-bot: :white_check_mark: image build queued: redwood/serving:emergency-grpc-patch-2432119999. will push to canary registry when ready.

maria: note for owners: revert any local vendor changes that bumped grpc-stream today. keep changes scoped to a single patch branch.

tay: after canary passes we'll run the streaming-cat stress for 1h (script: `./tools/streaming_cat --duration=3600 --parallel=50`). please don't merge until i ack.

maria: thanks all. i'll update the train channel in 2h with status. if we need >12h we'll re-open the thread and set a new ETA. :slightly_smiling_face:
